upstream_sources.integration: selected standalone skills; not the full Superpowers plugin or bootstrap

notes: Anthropic docx/pdf/xlsx/pptx source-available skills are excluded due to their license restrictions; original interoperable replacements are included.
The separate quality-first-efficiency companion pack is not counted in these 16 skills.
Installer resolves Hermes native Windows data home using LOCALAPPDATA\hermes, WSL/Linux using ~/.hermes, and honors HERMES_HOME overrides.
